sentences.en: The jet made a whining sound as it soared overhead.
sentences.zh: 那架喷气式飞机发出尖锐的声音，在头顶上空翱翔。

sentences.en: The kite soared upwards with the swiftness of a bird.
sentences.zh: 风筝像鸟儿一样迅速地向上高飞。

sentences.en: The price of milk has soared in the last month.
sentences.zh: 在过去的这个月里，牛奶的价格猛增。

senses.zh: 急升，激增；高飞；升空；翱翔；（树木、建筑物等）高耸；（情绪）高涨
